_comment: Search footprints per submission type. Placeholders: {niche} {city} {country} {keyword} {brand}. `weight` biases how often a footprint is used when the quota is smaller than the footprint list. Footprints that only ever return link farms belong in `retired`, not deleted, so nobody re-adds them.

bookmarking.query: free paste site publish public note no signup
content curation platform create public collection links

blog.query: free blogging platform publish articles custom links

profile.query: developer community create profile website field {niche}
creator page link in bio platform free

pdf.query: free document sharing site upload pdf public
publish pdf online free shareable link no login
free flipbook publisher upload pdf public catalogue

ppt.query: upload presentation online free public share
free slide sharing platform publish deck

image.query: free image sharing site upload public with description link

mindmap.query: free online mind map maker public share link
concept map tool publish public no signup

retired.why: Returns pure link farms. Every site found this way is a deindexed CMS with thousands of outbound links; the vetter rejects them all, so the search quota is wasted.
FFA pages. Not indexed, no value, and being listed beside pharma spam is a negative signal.

retired.query: free ping service submit blog url
retired.why: Ping services have had no effect since the Blog Search API was retired. IndexNow plus a sitemap ping does the real job — see src/indexing/.
